reason: The hypothesis combines the specific repair problem of 34CrNiMo6 steel (P1) with the electrospark deposition of HEA/ceramic composite coatings (P18, P24, P26, P45) into a single proposal, which no single passage does. It transfers the ESPD+HEA approach, previously shown on other substrates (A516 steel, Ti-6Al-4V, 316L), to the repair of a high-strength Cr-Ni-Mo steel with a stated reason (avoiding hot cracking), and links the evidence through a mechanism of in situ ceramic reinforcement within a rapidly solidified HEA matrix that none of the passages explicitly states for this material system.
